## Security review: dependency update 765aa8b2..aefd20ab

**Workflow security — no findings.** The only workflow change is `jdx/mise-action` `b44d12e7…` → `236a21c3b91f5db6d4e174b348674a0f0caac06d # v5.2.9` in dev.yml, stable.yml (1 hunk each) and validation.yml (6 hunks). Every hunk is a single-line `uses:` change; full 40-hex SHA and version comment retained. Worktree files confirm all other external actions unchanged and SHA-pinned with comments (actions/checkout v7.0.1, upload-artifact v7.0.2, download-artifact v8.0.2). Permissions unchanged: top-level `contents: read`; `contents: write` only on tag/release jobs; `id-token: write` only on publish jobs. Triggers unchanged (no `tags` filter; publish stays branch-push-only). Required job names (`check`, `windows`, `installers`, `branch-model`, `version`) intact. Boundary: with no network access I could not confirm the new SHA maps to the v5.2.9 tag content — but the reference is the immutable SHA itself, so no mutable reference was introduced; only the comment's accuracy is unverified.

**Dependency provenance — no findings.** bun.lock changes are npm-registry version and sha512-integrity updates only (this lockfile format carries no URLs); no git/tarball/http overrides, no new hosts, no credentials, no unversioned references. New transitive deps are ordinary (e.g. `@solidjs/signals@2.0.0`, `@isaacs/nonrecursive-glob-match@1.1.0`, `guarded-fetch@0.1.3` via just-bash 3.6.1). pi-packages.json and pypi-packages.json bump only already-pinned packages (no new names): pi-subagents 0.26.0, billion-context 0.1.216, @opencode/browse 0.1.1, browser-use 1.0.6.

**Scope — no findings.** Generated bundles match declared updates: embedded package ranges (^0.9.0, solid-js ^2.0.0), TUI_LOCK entries matching bun.lock (@opentui/core 0.9.2, marked 18.0.11), setup-tui.js pins matching pi-packages.json; the rest is minified third-party churn (just-bash/bash internals, @babel 7.29.14, claude-code 2.1.326).

Non-blocking: the just-bash exact pin was removed (`3.6.0` → `^3.0.0`, resolves 3.6.1) — a deliberate, tested policy change (EXACT_PACKAGES now empty) matching AGENTS.md's caret-range rule; CI installs use `--frozen-lockfile`.

Unaudited: third-party package internals (claude-code binaries, just-bash, Pi extensions); integrity rests on lockfile sha512, not this review.
